exception_type: ServerWatchdog forced shutdown: A single server tick took 60.00 seconds
raw_log:
[minecraft/ServerWatchdog]: A single server tick took 60.00 seconds (should be max 0.05)
[minecraft/ServerWatchdog]: Considering it to be crashed, server will forcibly shutdown.
fix_solution:
In the file browser, click on the server.properties file.

Click Edit at the top.

Scroll down and locate the max-tick-time option.

Change the option after the = to -1
max-tick-time=-1

Click the Save button at the top of the editor to save your changes.

Start your server.
notes: 场景:watchdog; Watchdog 超时报错信息本身不含 Java 异常类名,exception_type 按原文消息填写。托管商知识库教学文章:raw_log 为该文引用的报错特征原文(非某台真实服务器的完整崩溃报告,通常无插件列表/系统信息),fix_solution 为该文修复步骤原文;故质量不评 high。;清洗2026-08-28:fix=保留KB原文;quality=low→low
